design.summary: Use a three-task sequence: localize the default-suite stall with bounded evidence, repair only the proven cause, then run one exact-SHA workflow and verify both adapter execution and cleanup.
boundaries: Repository gates: default make test and its CI wrapper
Adapter integrations: browser/Docker live execution and cleanup
Evidence boundary: run identity, TAP summaries, artifacts, and postconditions
design.failurePolicy: Any missing, skipped, stalled, cancelled, or incomplete required evidence remains blocked and is recorded explicitly.

tasks.title: Localize the default Repository gates stall
tasks.spikeCandidate: Determine whether the stall is test:scan, a child process leak, or hosted-runner behavior using a disposable local copy and bounded CI diagnostics; do not write to the live repository during the spike.
tasks.actions: Compare normal default-suite timings with the stalled run, identify the last emitted test boundary, inspect child-process cleanup and timeout behavior, and add only the minimum diagnostic or command boundary needed to identify the cause.
tasks.acceptanceSignal: A bounded reproduction or CI diagnostic identifies the exact command/process boundary responsible for the stall, with expected result: a named root cause and retained log evidence.
tasks.acceptanceEvidence: Local test-scan completed 1283/1283 in about 3.5 minutes, and rerun 33726800933 completed Repository gates successfully in about seven minutes; no scan code defect was reproduced.
tasks.recoveryNote: If the cause is external runner behavior, leave the task blocked with the exact capability evidence; do not add an arbitrary timeout that masks a failing test.

tasks.title: Repair the proven default-suite or cleanup blocker
tasks.spikeCandidate: None after T001; any new cause must return to research before implementation.
tasks.actions: Implement the smallest fix for the identified stall or cleanup postcondition, add a regression test for the observed failure, synchronize generated payloads where applicable, and preserve diagnostic artifacts and original exit status.
tasks.acceptanceSignal: The focused regression test for the identified cause passes and reproduces the former failure as a passing case without any skip or relaxed assertion.
tasks.acceptanceEvidence: Current workflow adds docker update --restart=no before bounded removal retries; adapter wiring, formatting, whitespace, and repository checks pass locally.
tasks.recoveryNote: If validation exposes a different failure, preserve the failed evidence and return to T001 research rather than stacking speculative patches.
